desc:
🐱 The Dairy Cats need your help! Evil Gibblers are invading the dairy lands to steal milk and hidden treasures.

🛡️ Build your defense, summon powerful cats, and stop the invasion!

🥛 Earn Milk by winning battles and summon stronger units.

☠️ Think you're ready? Challenge Oblivion Mode if you dare!

👍 Like the game to support future updates!
